certification.name: Certified Internet of Things Security Practitioner
certification.description: 120-minute, 100-item multiple-choice and multiple-response exam (ITS-110) on securing IoT devices, networks, data, software and firmware. Valid for three years.
certification.currency_note: Exam voucher listed at $367.50 in the CertNexus store, rounded up; delivered through Pearson VUE
